content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced HR, payroll and PEO services with workers' comp; Goosehead places personal and commercial insurance rather than running HR outsourcing."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Billboard advertising, broadband and insurance are separate businesses; its insurance is a minor unit, not a core agency franchise."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Independent insurance brokerage placing personal and commercial coverage for commissions, selling to the same mix of households and businesses."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Managed care and claims cost containment for employers and insurers; it does not sell or place policies for customers."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced claims adjusting for insurers and employers; it resolves claims rather than selling coverage to consumers."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Licensed agents place carrier policies for consumers and earn carrier commissions, though focused on health and Medicare lines."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Sells consumer insurance leads and referrals to agencies per lead; it does not place policies or earn commissions as an agency."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Advertising, media buying and public relations for brands; a marketing services business with no insurance distribution."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Insurance brokerage placing commercial and personal lines for commissions, with wholesale and retail distribution similar to Goosehead."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Insurer that underwrites risk and pays claims from premiums; it bears underwriting risk unlike a distribution agency."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Independent agency selling personal, commercial and life coverage for carrier commissions, closely matching Goosehead's model in a regional footprint."}]}
